description: Evaluation configuration for CodeClue MRLF generalization plan

dev.purpose: Iterate freely. All examined repos go here.
dev.notes: click was examined during blind-eval debugging (April 13-14) — contaminated, moved to dev

validation.purpose: Hyperparameter tuning only. Never examine source code for debugging.
validation.notes: Former blind repos promoted to validation. Gold tasks exist.

blind.purpose: One-time final evaluation. Never examine source code for any reason.
selection_criteria: At least 2 languages (one must differ from dev set languages)
At least 1 repo with minimal/no docstrings (tests graceful degradation)
At least 1 repo with 500K+ tokens (tests scale)
At least 1 repo with non-English or heavily abbreviated naming

relational.description: Call graph, inheritance, class hierarchy edges

mechanistic.description: Internal logic, precedence chains, control flow, return construction

invariant.description: Error handling guarantees, security properties, resource lifecycle

requirements: Each fact must include: statement, file+lines evidence, knowledge_type
Facts written by reading source code, not by running the format
Each fact must include expected_answerable_tier (file1 or file2)

overfitting_detection.description: If Dev accuracy exceeds Validation accuracy by >10 percentage points on any knowledge type, the change is overfitting. Revert.
